name: Customizable Wrench with Nut holding Cap

captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a mini wrench tool with a flat profile. One end features a closed-ring box wrench with a hexagonal hole, while the opposite end is an open-ended wrench cutout. The central handle is a simple rectangular bar connecting the two functional heads, and the closed-ring end can optionally feature a thin retaining cap on top.
captions.instruction: Create a parametric, customizable mini wrench in OpenSCAD with an open-end wrench on one side and a closed box-end wrench on the other. Include parameters for the target nut size, tool thickness, tool length multiplier, custom engraved text on the handle, and an optional thin holding cap for the box end.
captions.factory: The wrench is constructed using a central `cube` for the handle, joined with two `cylinder` shapes at each end using a `union` operation. A `difference` operation then cuts out a hexagonal shape (using a custom hexagon module) from both ends; on the open end, an additional `cube` is subtracted to create the open jaw. If the holding cap is enabled, extra thin cylinders are placed on the top and bottom of the box end, and a small circular hole is subtracted through the center.
